outcome: Surgical management (first-stage closure, hindgut rescue with end colostomy, unification of hindgut segments)
Discharge home on full enteral feeds
cohort: A single premature infant boy presenting with the OEIS complex and fully duplicated blind-ending hindguts.
finding: This case highlights the rare co-occurrence of OEIS complex and hindgut duplications, which was successfully managed surgically by unifying the distinct hindguts to maximize mucosal surface area.
